channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Sierra Leone Ex-Ruler Returns Home After Treason Charges Dropped
item.description: Former Sierra Leone President Ernest Bai Koroma, accused of plotting to overthrow the government, has returned from Nigeria after criminal charges against him were dropped.
item.dc:creator: Modou Joof

item.title: Lavrov Warns That Germany Is Moving Toward War With Russia
item.description: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov accused Germany of moving toward a direct confrontation with Russia as he criticized Berlin’s decision to close some diplomatic offices after a drone incident at Leipzig airport.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News

item.title: Zelenskyy Sees No Fast End to War After Meeting With US Envoys
item.description: Ukraine is resigned to Russia’s war dragging on through another tough winter and is looking for a “package” from allies that would cover air defense reinforcements as well as energy, including US LNG.
item.dc:creator: Olesia Safronova and Volodymyr Verbianyi

item.title: German Far-Right AfD Secures 44.5% in Saxony-Anhalt Vote, CDU Trails
item.description: The far-right Alternative for Germany scored its best-ever result in a state election on Sunday amid growing public discontent with the political establishment, delivering a powerful blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz and the country’s political establishment.
item.dc:creator: Kamil Kowalcze, Arne Delfs and Michael Nienaber

item.title: Trump’s ‘Erratic’ Tariffs Undermine Economy, House Democrat Says
item.description: Democratic Representative Haley Stevens blasted the “erratic” tariff war that President Donald Trump started with Canada, saying her home state of Michigan is bearing much of the economic fallout from the trade dispute.
item.dc:creator: Isabelle Lee, Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason

item.title: French National Rally’s Bardella on Budget, AI, Ukraine
item.description: France's National Rally will oppose any proposals by the current government for tax increases in the next budget, according to the president of the far-right party, Jordan Bardella. He also touted the strong transatlantic relationship with the US, and said he believes France should receive something from Ukraine in exchange for continued support. Bardella spoke exclusively with Bloomberg Television Anchor Francine Lacqua from Lake Como in Cernobbio, Italy. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bardella ‘Certain’ to Oppose Tax Increase in French Budget Fight
item.description: Jordan Bardella, head of the far-right National Rally party, set out his red lines for the battle over narrowing France’s yawning budget deficit ahead of the 2027 presidential campaign, vowing to fight any tax hike on households and business.
item.dc:creator: James Hertling and Francine Lacqua

item.title: France’s Far-Right Chief Bardella Wants Ukraine to Pay for Europe’s Help
item.description: Jordan Bardella, president of the far-right National Rally party, said France’s unconditional support for Ukraine should be replaced by a more transactional relationship with the embattled country.
item.dc:creator: Samy Adghirni and Francine Lacqua

item.title: US Energy Chief Says Navy to Defend Hormuz Until Iran Backs Down
item.description: US Navy escorts that are helping tankers cross the Strait of Hormuz are essential to sustaining crude flows through the waterway, Energy Secretary Chris Wright said Sunday, suggesting they won’t end anytime soon.
item.dc:creator: Jennifer A. Dlouhy and María Paula Mijares Torres

item.title: Rep. Kiley Challenges Party Control in Congress
item.description: Joining Bloomberg This Weekend, Independent California Rep. Kevin Kiley is calling for House rules to guarantee committee assignments for lawmakers who don't belong to either major party, after his own assignments were temporarily vacated when he left the Republican Conference. Kiley also criticizes mid-decade gerrymandering and said he supports mail voting while arguing that nationwide election policy should be set by Congress rather than executive order. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Rallies GOP Ahead of Midterm Elections
item.description: Republicans are preparing for a first-of-its-kind midterm convention in Dallas on Sept. 9 and 10, with President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance among the featured speakers as the party seeks to mobilize voters ahead of November. Joining Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend is Co-host of Bloomberg's Balance of Power Kailey Leinz and she says that the gathering will also spotlight competitive races including the Texas Senate contest, even as some Republicans in swing districts plan to stay away and campaign at home. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Unions Gains Support as AI Reshapes Work
item.description: A Gallup poll shows 71% of Americans approve of labor unions and a record 47% want them to have more influence, while 52% of Republicans also approve. Joining Bloomberg This Weekend is AFL-CIO President Liz Shuler and she says unions are organizing around wages, AI and the midterms as House Republicans investigate whether some unions improperly used member dues for political activity, allegations Shuler rejects. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Democrats See Wider Path to Take Senate as Trump Backlash Grows
item.description: Senate Republicans in Dallas this week for the party’s unusual midterm election convention could use a good show.
item.dc:creator: Steven T. Dennis

item.title: Labour Says Farage Must Answer for Foreign Donations Scandal
item.description: Britain’s Labour Party said Nigel Farage should take responsibility for fresh allegations about illicit funding that enveloped his Reform UK party as members gathered for its annual conference last week.
item.dc:creator: Irina Anghel

item.title: Spain Takes Over Ceuta’s Port to House, Return Thousands of Migrants
item.description: Spain’s government has taken over Ceuta’s port to shelter hundreds of migrants living on streets and beaches more than a month after a mass influx entering from Morocco overwhelmed the North African enclave.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Basteiro

item.title: US Envoys, Zelenskyy Joined by European Allies in Kyiv Meeting
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met with President Donald Trump’s envoys in Kyiv, a day after Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held talks with Moscow with President Vladimir Putin in pursuit of a way to end Russia’s war in Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Volodymyr Verbianyi and Olesia Safronova

item.title: Italy Should Tax Banks Like Spain, Says Vice Premier Salvini
item.description: Italy’s right-wing Vice Premier Matteo Salvini says Spain’s Socialist leader Pedro Sánchez has gotten it right when it comes to taxing banks.
item.dc:creator: Donato Paolo Mancini

item.title: Iran, US Trade Tit-for-Tat Tanker Attacks as War Drags On
item.description: Iran said it targeted three oil tankers using an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz, as well as a number of US-linked ships, in retaliation for American attacks on Iranian tankers over the weekend.
item.dc:creator: Eltaf Najafizada and Weilun Soon

item.title: Russia’s Ryazan Oil Refinery Catches Fire After Drone Strike
item.description: Ukraine’s General Staff said Rosneft PJSC’s oil refinery in Ryazan, one of Russia’s largest, was hit overnight, with a fire recorded in the area as US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff arrived in Kyiv from Moscow following talks with President Vladimir Putin.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News

item.title: German Far Right Heads for Historic State Win: What to Watch
item.description: Germany’s far right is expected to notch a decisive election victory in Saxony-Anhalt on Sunday, a result that could put the Alternative for Germany, or AfD, closer than ever to leading one of the country’s 16 states.
item.dc:creator: Kamil Kowalcze
